info.title: API.SH: Zhaopin
info.description: The Zhaopin API from API.SH: public Zhaopin data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A company on Zhaopin: name, number, logo, size, ownership type, industries, financing stage, city, address and coordinates, description, website, working hours and rest days, highlights (benefits), office addresses, photos, interview notes candidates left (text, result, date), rating where shown, the number of open jobs and the open jobs themselves (20 per page). Pass `jobs_next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zhaopin-company

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Company number (e.g. CZ683517220) or its zhaopin.com/companydetail link.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of the company's open jobs (1-based).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The site's filter lists with their codes, one list per call: cities (provinces, cities and districts), hot_cities, overseas, industries, job_categories (three levels), salary, education, experience, job_kind, company_type, company_size, financing. Use the codes in /zhaopin/v1/search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zhaopin-filters

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Which list.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One job ad on Zhaopin: title, status, salary text and the parsed range in CNY with its period, bonus, city, district, full work address and coordinates, education, experience, job kind, openings, category, skills and labels, welfare, the full description, internship terms, publication date, the recruiter's display name, title and activity as the ad shows them, and the company (name, number, link, logo, size, industry, financing, description, open jobs). Give the job number or link, or `q` (plus any search filter) to open the first matching current ad.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zhaopin-job

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Job number (e.g. CC683517220J40918806413) or its zhaopin.com/jobdetail link.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Job link (jobs.zhaopin.com or www.zhaopin.com/jobdetail).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Instead of number: open the first current job for this keyword.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: With q: city code or name.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Job ads on Zhaopin (智联招聘, China) by keyword and city or district, with the site's filters: monthly salary range, minimum education, experience, job kind (full time, part time, internship, campus), company type and size, industry and job category codes; sorted by relevance, newest or highest salary. Each job has its number, title, link, salary text and the parsed range in CNY with its period (month, day or hour), city, district and street, education, experience, job kind, category, skills and tags, publication dates, the company (name, number, link, logo, size, type, industry) and the recruiter's display name and title as the ad shows them. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zhaopin-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword (e.g. java, 销售, 产品经理).

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City or district: the site's code (e.g. 530 Beijing, 538 Shanghai, 765 Shenzhen) or its name in Chinese or pinyin. See /zhaopin/v1/filters?type=cities.

parameters.name: salary
parameters.description: Monthly salary range in CNY, min-max (e.g. 10001-15000).

parameters.name: education
parameters.description: Minimum education, comma separated: junior-high, high-school, secondary-vocational, associate, bachelor, master, mba, doctorate.

parameters.name: experience
parameters.description: Experience, comma separated: none, under-1, 1-3, 3-5, 5-10, 10-plus.

parameters.name: job_kind
parameters.description: full-time, part-time, internship, campus (comma separated).

parameters.name: company_type
parameters.description: state-owned, foreign, joint-venture, hk-macau-taiwan, private, public-institution, other (comma separated).

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: Industry codes, comma separated (see /zhaopin/v1/filters?type=industries).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Job category codes (the most specific level), comma separated (see /zhaopin/v1/filters?type=job_categories).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Results page (1-based). Pass next_page back; it is null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (1-20, default 20).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/zhaopin-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Partial keyword (e.g. java, 销售).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
